title: Expressions of Interest – Civil Designers, Civil Engineers & Structural Engineers
location: Melbourne VIC (also Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast)
content_text: Projex Partners is inviting Expressions of Interest from experienced and emerging professionals in civil design, civil engineering, and structural engineering to join our growing team. Locations: Melbourne | Brisbane | Gold Coast | Sunshine Coast. What we're looking for: Civil Designers with strong 2D/3D design capability; Civil Engineers with infrastructure and urban development experience; Structural Engineers with commercial, residential, or industrial project exposure; Collaborative, detail-focused professionals who value practical design outcomes. To apply or express interest: Please send your CV and a short introduction outlining your experience and preferred location. Apply Now via on-page contact form. Contact email published on the Contact page: contact@projexpartners.com.au. Date on page: 08 June, 2026.
apply_instructions: Submit CV and short introduction via the Apply Now form on the EOI page, or email contact@projexpartners.com.au (published on https://www.projexpartners.com.au/contact/). Preferred location Melbourne.
